productBugs.symptom: Same defect the contracts seat recorded: a confirmed send moves the Contract to a Signature Status with no Soft gate and no override entry. A direct send also does this from Active or Ended, clearing endedAt. Report once with the contracts seat's entry.
productBugs.contradicts: CTR-012 Soft gate and CONTEXT.md Soft gate; no decision record covers the send-time Status advance.

sharedFileRequests.request: 'A preparation does not enter the Signature Stage automatically when the provider sends it' is wrong since b6a0bcfd: transitions.ts calls advanceSentContractStage when a prepared draft is confirmed sent, signed or declined, if the Status has not changed since preparation. Also add that this move, like the direct send's, skips the Soft gate.

The send steps omit the required question 'Will the agreement be fully signed when this DocuSign round is complete?' (Yes, all required signatures will be in place / No, more signatures will still be needed). A No round files a Partially signed copy that is not pinned as executed and moves a Signature-Stage Contract to Partially signed, not Active. 'Follow completion' says filing always moves to Active.

'Wait for Executed copy' should name the interim text Filing the signed copy… and the failure text The signed copy could not be filed. Upload it to the record instead., which troubleshooting.md now quotes.
